I replied to Marcus in a thread under his message in #north-team: the main contact is **Thea Ramaswell**, Director of Yard Operations at Quarrendon Freight Lines.

Two sources say so, and Marcus can see both. On Aug 20, 2025, Dana posted in #north-team that Thea flagged the duplicate arrivals on door 6 again during the morning shift. The North team cheat sheet, a public file, also lists Thea as the main contact for Quarrendon Freight Lines. A contact name is account information that's fine to share with the North team, not a money figure, so no approval was needed.
